context: Request: which of the firm's fund and asset-management matters include a GP clawback, and pull the executed LPAs. Rubric: 1001-00002 (Ardent), 1003-00002 (Harrowgate), 1024-00002 (Driftwood), 1026-00001 (Briarwood Family Office: an LP-side review of a third-party fund the client passed on), 1027-00002 (Pellegrino), a proof document for each, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob. Review: partly (listing capped).

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store. Counts and lists all matter folder names. Review: yes.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script fails on a heredoc error, then times out with no output. Review: no.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Path search for request words, including a broad word that matches many unrelated files. Review: partly.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Narrower path search grouped by matter (attempt 2). Review: partly.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of six documents from two matters, then a snippet script over every file of 13 listed matters (about 540K chars). Review: no (claims about four matters rest on bulk snippets).

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Listings of 18 candidate matters filtered to names with agreement words. Review: partly.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the openings of documents in six matters, a snippet script on five documents, reads in a seventh matter and one path search for executed agreements. Review: partly (first lines only; one listed amendment unread).

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: A read refused because no stage was open, then the same read of an executed amendment in a reopened stage (attempt 2). Review: partly.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes seven matters as including the term and two executed agreements as the pull list. Review: partly.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits the count to eight by adding one more matter and re-reads the opening. Review: partly (added matter unverified).

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: An edit refused because no stage was open, then the same caveat edit in a reopened stage (attempt 2). Review: yes.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: All five needed matters were named, but the LP-side review matter is described as the sponsor's own engagement, and draft-only matters are asserted as qualifying.

first_error.why: It names the LP-side review matter but describes it as the sponsor's own engagement, although the review memo it read at [55]-[61] is addressed to the investor client.
first_error.critic_note: No review mentioned how that matter was described.

other_errors.why: It also asserts matters that have only draft or markup documents, picked from a bulk snippet scan; after the review it read one opening of two of them and kept them (evidence seen at [34]-[73]).
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [46] named two of these matters as resting on bulk snippets; the agent read one document of each and kept them.

runs.failure_point: All five needed matters and their documents are named, but the LP-side review matter is described as the sponsor's own engagement.

first_error.why: It names the LP-side review matter as the sponsor's own engagement, although the review memo it read at [36]-[50] is addressed to the investor client reviewing another sponsor's terms.
first_error.critic_note: No review mentioned how that matter was described.

divergence: T0 and T2 reached all five matters through file-name searches and both failed one criterion the same way at the write stage: the LP-side review matter was described as the sponsor's own engagement (misstated facts), which no review named. T0 additionally asserted draft-only matters taken from a bulk snippet scan (over-inclusion) that the review had questioned; T2 read its chosen matters in depth and held to them. T1's first store-wide scan printed uncapped snippets (about 40M chars) and the context filled before any review (context overflow).
